newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn rated 62 pct good-to-excellent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn rated 62 pct good-to-excellent.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture rated 3 percent of the corn crop in very poor condition, 9 percent poor, 26 percent fair, 47 percent good and 15 percent excellent.
The department pegged 3 percent of the soybean crop in very poor condition, 10 percent poor, 30 percent fair, 46 percent good and 11 percent excellent.
USDA said 50 percent of the spring wheat crop had been harvested versus 29 percent a week ago and the five-year average of 45 percent.
USDA pegged 4 percent of the cotton crop in very poor condition, 9 percent poor, 24 percent fair, 46 percent good and 17 percent excellent.
The department said 18 percent of the corn crop was dented versus the five year average of 34 percent.
It said 80 percent of the soybean crop was setting pods compared with 63 percent last week and the five-year average of 85 percent.
